llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent: it calls Quick Intel's scan API and requires payment via the x402 protocol. Before installing or using it: 1) Prefer a managed wallet integration (Sponge, AgentWallet, Vincent, Lobster.cash) so you never expose private keys to the agent; 2) If you must use programmatic signing, only put a dedicated hot-wallet private key (with minimal funds, e.g., $1–$5 USDC) in an environment variable — never your main trading wallet; 3) Verify endpoint domains (x402.quickintel.io, api.wallet.paysponge.com, frames.ag) and the legitimacy of the Quick Intel service independently before sending payments; 4) Be cautious in multi-user or shared CI environments where env vars could be leaked; and 5) If you want stronger assurance, ask the publisher for a homepage or published repo/release and validate the x402 pay-to addresses and behavior off-agent first.
